description: Prateek's canonical Xcode / iOS runtime / device triple for new iOS projects. Pinned to the latest stable Xcode that runs on the installed macOS, with the iOS runtime matching its SDK. Read by ios-project-scaffold and ios.md. Update on quarterly review.

rationale.xcode: Latest stable Xcode that runs on macOS 26.4. Xcode 27.0 requires macOS 26.6, so move to it after the macOS update.
rationale.runtime: iOS 26.5 matches Xcode 26.6's iOS SDK. CI runner images may lag this pin and need a runtime download step: `xcodes runtimes install "iOS 26.5"`.
rationale.devices: Current-year flagship phone and tablet, both supported by the iOS 26.5 runtime.
